Zhaolong Interconnect.why: Makes high-speed copper (DAC / active copper) cable assemblies and 112G/224G-per-lane cable for AI data-center switch and server links; its stock benefits directly from AI rack copper interconnect demand.
Zhaolong Interconnect.evidence: Zhaolong Interconnect 2026 half-year report (08-29-2026): 112Gb/s-per-lane high-speed cable in stable volume supply, 224Gb/s in small-batch delivery; passive copper products include QSFP-DD800 / OSFP800 / OSFP1600.

players.product: High-speed copper cable assemblies for AI data centers: passive (DAC) and active copper cables incl. QSFP-DD800 / OSFP800 / OSFP1600, 112G and 224G per-lane high-speed cable, and in-server PCIe 5.0/6.0 cable assemblies

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhaolong Interconnect half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 122,049.43 ten-thousand, up 25.60% YoY; net profit attributable RMB 10,586.03 ten-thousand, up 18.13%. Category 6A-and-above data cable sales up 39.51%, special cable (incl. high-speed transmission cable) up 67.98% (gross margin 44.33%), connection products up 23.51%; overseas revenue up 29.40%, domestic up 19.25%.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 122,049.43 ten-thousand (+25.60%); net profit RMB 10,586.03 ten-thousand (+18.13%); special cable +67.98%; connection products +23.51%

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhaolong Interconnect half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: high-speed interconnect is a key growth engine - with overseas and domestic cloud providers raising compute capex, orders for its high-speed cables and connection products keep growing fast; 112Gb/s-per-lane high-speed cable is in stable volume supply, 224Gb/s-per-lane cable is in small-batch delivery, and 1.6Tb/s high-speed assemblies are in customer validation.

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhaolong Interconnect half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: the company offers a full range of 10Gb/s to 1.6Tb/s high-speed cable assemblies - passive copper (SFP56 to QSFP-DD800, OSFP800, OSFP1600) and active copper with signal-processing chips in the connectors - plus in-server PCIe 5.0/6.0 cable assemblies (MCIO, SlimSAS and others); it can mass-produce assemblies and cable for rates up to 800Gb/s and is developing 448Gb/s-per-lane interconnect.

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhaolong Interconnect half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: the domestic high-speed cable and connection products smart-manufacturing project is installing equipment and releasing capacity; part of the Thailand base is in scale production and its self-built plant is under construction.
